compressor-cord.core_section_frame: Two perpendicular axes transported along the common centreline; first axis is projected world X at entry.
compressor-cord.description: Three-core SJOOW through the fore floor lane. Switched H and neutral fan out to their separate 221-413 joins beneath the funnel; PE remains continuous to the rear-wall earth stack.
compressor-cord.fanout_note: The jacket ends 12 mm into the fore end of the shared centreline. Its switched-hot and neutral cores finish at the final-connection WAGOs; PE runs continuously to the rear-wall earth stack.

reed-column-a.description: Five continuous reservoir A reed conductors follow the lid beside the PSU, open into an ordered five-wire ribbon through the integral level hook, then repack above the aligned rear cap bore. Four signal lanes and one common spine continue through the dry reed channel.

reed-column-b.description: Five conductors leave reservoir B's dry reed channel through the shell-rim notch and follow one exposed route beside the cap. Four signals terminate at J7; the common terminates at wago-reeds-b. Four signal lanes and one continuous common spine occupy the reed channel.

temperature-bus.description: The parallel temperature bus joins the coil probe first, then continues outside the evaporator copper around the fore quarter of the vessel to the bulk-temperature probe taps.

sensor-cable.description: Six signal conductors surround the separate protective-earth core through the offset cap passage. The signal trunk follows the clear west aisle to its PCB and WAGO fanouts.

carbonator-earth.description: The 16 AWG earth conductor occupies the center of the shared cap passage and reaches the rear-wall ring stack below C14.

condenser-fan-pair.description: The two 1.70 mm condenser-fan leads share the east-wall clip and one transported lower course. The negative retains its upper J2 manifold-bank passage; the positive leaves the manifold common directly.

gas-sensor-ribbon.description: The four J11 conductors leave the board together, descend in the open gap between the west valve columns, cross the enclosure seam inboard, and share the low west-wall hook. The transported lower ribbon rises above the sensor board before its fore pin fanouts.
gas-sensor-ribbon.core_section_frame: Initial section components transport into a vertical 1.85mm conductor pitch at the Y82..98 hook land.
